item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Square Crop Keeps Whole Sneaker

turns.text: Make this wide photo square for an Instagram post. Keep the whole sneaker in view, and don't stretch it or change anything else.

item.tests: Tests converting a 16:9 photo to square while preserving the complete subject and its proportions.

answer_sheet.Subject to preserve: The entire white sneaker, including the toe and heel.
answer_sheet.Style, text and other edits: Keep the original photo appearance. No added text or other edits.

must_haves: The sneaker is the same white leather sneaker as in the attachment.
The entire sneaker, including toe, heel and sole, remains visible.
The sneaker has natural proportions, without stretching or squeezing.
The retained floor and background match the source photo, with no added text or decorative elements.

approvals.name: edit_image

args.name: Keep It Classic — Sneaker Social Post

style.prompt: Create a polished square social media post using the white sneaker in the supplied photograph. Preserve the exact sneaker design, side profile, white color, stitching, laces, sole shape and proportions. Remove the cluttered room and tabletop completely. Place the sneaker as a large hero product across the lower middle of a minimalist warm light-gray studio background with a soft realistic contact shadow and subtle tonal circular backdrop. Refined editorial sneaker aesthetic, crisp detail, restrained black typography. Add the headline 'KEEP IT CLASSIC' in bold clean uppercase sans-serif at the top with ample whitespace. Add small text 'THE WHITE SNEAKER EDIT' beneath the headline. Balanced professional composition with generous margins. No logos, no invented brand, no price, no discount, no extra shoes. Product is the main focus.
